provenance: Sanitized mechanisms adapted from real Memlog lessons; project and customer identifiers removed.

entries.title: Check upstream status before parsing an error body
entries.problem: A remote 404 with plain text was reported as a local JSON parser failure.
entries.cause: The wrapper deserialized every response before checking HTTP status, masking the actionable upstream response.
entries.prevention: Preserve status and sanitized body first; parse only successful responses.

entries.title: A desired-state API update removes list items that are not restated
entries.problem: Promoting one release silently removed an existing release from the destination track.
entries.cause: The update endpoint replaced the complete release list instead of applying a delta.
entries.prevention: Read current state and either preserve every supported field or refuse unsafe automation.

entries.title: Assert rendered visibility rather than a reveal class
entries.problem: A page shipped blank while the test confirmed that the reveal class was present.
entries.cause: The assertion checked an implementation marker instead of effective opacity through the ancestor chain.
entries.prevention: Test pixels or computed user-visible outcomes and mutation-test the guard.

entries.title: A content-negotiation test must send the negotiated header
entries.problem: A command-line probe appeared to prove that locale routing ignored French visitors.
entries.cause: The probe sent no language preference and therefore measured only the default fallback.
entries.prevention: Send explicit headers for both branches plus a no-header control.

entries.title: A create-only configuration import fixes new environments only
entries.problem: Editing the tracked configuration did not change already provisioned environments.
entries.cause: The loader skipped existing state instead of reconciling or replacing it.
entries.prevention: Pair declarative changes with an explicit migration path and verify loader flags.

entries.title: Concurrent mutation checks need isolated working trees
entries.problem: Two reviewers produced inconsistent mutation-test results on the same checkout.
entries.cause: Each process edited and restored the same tracked files while the other process was testing.
entries.prevention: Give state-mutating workers separate worktrees or run them sequentially.
